abstract: BACKGROUND Primary retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma is a rare form of extragonadal germ cell tumor that is highly aggressive and responds poorly to chemoradiation. Extragonadal choriocarcinomas are notoriously challenging to diagnose, and have often progressed to advanced disease by the time of diagnosis. The survival rate for extragonadal choriocarcinoma is approximately 30%, which is much lower than that of extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (GCT) in general. CASE REPORT A 24-year-old man with no significant past medical history presented with left-sided, pleuritic chest pain and back pain radiating down his left leg, of 1-year duration. Computed tomography (CT) of the chest revealed multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules and a CT of the abdomen and pelvis showed a large heterogeneous soft tissue mass measuring 9.3×8×10.5 cm. A CT-guided core needle biopsy of a lung nodule was performed and the findings were consistent with the diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain was negative for metastatic disease. Tumor markers were significant for a markedly elevated beta human chorionic gonadotropin (B-hCG) of 104 712 mIU/mL. He was diagnosed with a stage IIIC germ cell tumor, further classified as a primary retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma with lung metastasis, and was started on urgent inpatient chemotherapy. CONCLUSIONS Due to the poor outcomes associated with extragonadal choriocarcinoma, it is important to promptly and correctly identify this malignancy in order to initiate treatment in a timely manner. The following case report explores the histopathologic characterization of this malignancy and describes the clinical course and outcomes from treatment for this patient.

背景：原発性後腹膜絨毛癌は、きわめて侵襲性が高く化学放射線療法に反応しにくい、まれな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍です。性腺外絨毛癌は診断が非常に困難であることで知られ、診断時にはすでに進行した病期に至っていることが多いです。性腺外絨毛癌の生存率は約30%であり、性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍全般の生存率と比べてはるかに低いです。

症例報告：既往歴に特記事項のない24歳男性が、1年間続く左側の胸膜性胸痛と左脚へ放散する背部痛を主訴に来院しました。胸部CTでは両側多発性肺結節が認められ、腹部骨盤CTでは9.3×8×10.5 cmの大きな不均一な軟部組織腫瘤が認められました。肺結節のCTガイド下コア針生検を行ったところ、転移性絨毛癌の診断と一致する所見が得られました。頭部MRIでは転移性疾患は陰性でした。腫瘍マーカーでは、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニット（β-hCG）が104,712 mIU/mLと著明に上昇していました。病期IIICの胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、さらに原発性後腹膜絨毛癌で肺転移を伴うものと分類されたため、緊急で入院化学療法を開始しました。

結論：性腺外絨毛癌の予後は不良であるため、治療を適時に開始するためには、本悪性腫瘍を速やかかつ正確に同定することが重要です。本症例報告では、この悪性腫瘍の病理組織学的特徴を検討し、本患者の臨床経過と治療転帰を記述します。
